village_philippa_fd_1.m: If a reward is what your after, then a reward you shall have.
r: So exciting! I can't wait. Let me have it.

village_philippa_fd_10.m: Yes. You need to get me some dough, two eggs, butter, honey and five Feygard fig fruits. I also need a bottle of wine. A splash for the pie and the rest of the bottle is for me. Oh don't forget, the figs cannot be found anywhere near those savages to the south.
r: Dough! Where am I supposed to find dough?
I've been across a great amount of Dhayavar and I've not seen honey anywhere.

village_philippa_fd_11.m: Well, Brightport is known for its wondeful bakeries. I would start there. Of course, you could get some in Feygard too. But you need to seek out a baker.

village_philippa_fd_12.m: How about trying a beekeeper? Geez, you are not the smartest are you?
r: You know what? Now that you mention it, I have met a beekeeper before. But where? Anyway, what about...
OK, but where do I find a beekeeper?

village_philippa_fd_12_bee.m: I don't know, kid. Somewhere along the Duleian Road? Towards those savages, maybe?

village_philippa_fd_13.m: Try a bakery. They always need butter.

village_philippa_fd_2_rude.m: Well, maybe with that attitude, you don't derserve one?
r: I'm sorry. You see, I'm just in love with the new stuff.

village_philippa_fd_3.m: Do you know what a "Feydelight" is?
r: Whatever happened to my reward? Thanks for nothing.

village_philippa_fd_4.m: Well, you see? I make them. Not to brag, but I am in fact, the best baker in Feygard.

village_philippa_fd_5.m: Let's get back to talking about those Feydelights.
r: You said that you bake them, but what is a "feydelight"?

village_philippa_fd_6.m: Child, they are a delicious fig pie enjoyed by most Feygardians as an after dinner delicacy, often reserved for holidays and other celebrations.
r: Is that my reward? A fig pie?

village_philippa_fd_7.m: Well, of course. But there is a problem.

village_philippa_fd_8.m: Well, as you are aware, we've been captive for so long. But what you are not aware of, is that while gone, all of my supplies have either gone rotten or been stolen.

village_philippa_fd_9.m: I need supplies. Ingredients to be more specific. I need eleven things, but six unique ingredients.

village_philippa_fd_all_items_1.m: Great. I will take them now. But I want to warn you, making this pie will take me a while. Come back later and it will be ready.

village_philippa_fd_all_items_2.m: Come back later and it will be ready.

village_philippa_fd_complete_no.m: Sorry, no it is not. Please come back later.

village_philippa_fd_complete_no_impatien.m: You know, my Feygard customers never pester me like this. They know to be patient and wait for this great delicacy.

village_philippa_fd_complete_yes.m: Yes. Please enjoy while it's hot.

village_philippa_fd_feygard_1.m: [With a not so appreciative look on here face...] Oh, sometimes I miss that magnificent place so much. Though, I am happier here.
r: I've never been there, so tell me, is it as great as I've been told?

village_philippa_fd_feygard_2.m: I've not the words to begin to describe its magnificence.

village_philippa_initial_phrase.m: Thank you for rescuing us earlier!
r: You're welcome, but I was hoping for more than gratitude.
You're welcome, but I wanted to talk about the "Feydelight" again.
I am wondering, is my Feydelight ready yet?

village_philippa_selector_has_ingredient.m: Were you successful in finding all of the items that I've requested of you?
r: Yes, I have everything that you asked for in order to bake the Feydelight.

village_philippa_selector_not_all_ingred.m: Did you find all the ingredients?
r: What do I need to do again to get my "Feydelight"?

village_philippa_try_fd.m: Would you like to try a piece before you dig into yours?
r: Yes, please. That would be great.

village_philippa_try_fd_1.m: Here you go. Eat it up while it's hot.
r: That was delicious! But what...is it...doing to me? I feel so funny.

village_philippa_try_fd_good.m: Oh, that? That's nothing. Just some side effects of great cooking.

feygard_delicacy.1: Philippa, one of the lovely Feygard loyalist ladies from Wexlow that I rescued from Gamjee the troll has informed me that she is a master baker.
feygard_delicacy.2: Philippa has educated me about what a "Feydelight" is.
feygard_delicacy.3: In return for my helping to rescue Philippa, she's stated that she could make a "Feydelight" for me if I provide her with all of the ingredients necessary to bake one.
feygard_delicacy.4: I need to find dough, two eggs, wine, butter, honey and five Feygard fig fruits. I can find the figs in Feygard, but maybe I could find some along the Duleian Road too?
feygard_delicacy.5: She told me that I can find the dough in Brightport or Feygard, but I could find a baker in just about any town.
feygard_delicacy.6: Philippa told me that I can get honey from a beekeeper. But where to find one?
feygard_delicacy.7: I gave Philippa all the ingredients needed to bake the Feydelight. Now I just need to come back later.
feygard_delicacy.8: I have received my Feydelight from Philippa.
